Glossary · Corporate finance

Acquisition अधिग्रहण (Acquisition)

One company buying control of another, with the target usually continuing as a subsidiary or being absorbed.

हिंदी में: अधिग्रहण (Acquisition)

एक कंपनी का दूसरी का नियंत्रण ख़रीदना; लक्षित कंपनी आमतौर पर सहायक बनी रहती है या उसी में मिल जाती है।

How it is used in the lessons

Large goodwill means the company paid a premium, and it can be written down if the acquisition disappoints.
